description: Ministry of Education - Notice of amendment to the Gaz. Ex. On. 1113/12 of 04.01.2000 , definition for the Trained Piiriven  Teacher
categorisation: This gazette notification contains an amendment to existing regulations under the Pirivena Education Act, No. 64, 1979. It modifies the qualification requirements for Trained Pirivena Teachers, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
